related.title: 巴斯郡抽蓄水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「配合風光基地的調節任務」與「變速機組與抽水調節」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；巴斯郡抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Balancing a wind and solar base" and "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bath County Pumped Storage Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界最大的 3,600 MW 抽蓄電站與柔性直流電網的配合；巴斯郡抽蓄水電站則以三千 MW 級抽蓄電站、上池水位驟降的土石壩與機組增容為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's largest pumped-storage station at 3,600 MW and its pairing with a VSC-HVDC grid; Bath County Pumped Storage Station centres on A 3,000 MW pumped-storage station, an embankment under rapid drawdown and unit uprating, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上池蓄能量」與「上池蓄能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「交流勵磁變速機組」的模型移到巴斯郡抽蓄水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「更換轉輪的增容工程」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Energy stored in the upper reservoir".
Move the model of "AC-excited variable-speed units" to Bath County Pumped Storage Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Uprating by replacing the runners", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「配合風光基地的調節任務」與「變速機組與抽水調節」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；巴斯郡抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Balancing a wind and solar base" and "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bath County Pumped Storage Station must be respecified.

related.title: 張北柔性直流電網
related.transfer: 可遷移「配合風光基地的調節任務」與「變速機組與抽水調節」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；張北柔性直流電網的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Balancing a wind and solar base" and "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界最大的 3,600 MW 抽蓄電站與柔性直流電網的配合；張北柔性直流電網則以世界第一個直流電網：四端環網、年輸送電量、子模組電容的儲能、故障電流的上升率與直流斷路器為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's largest pumped-storage station at 3,600 MW and its pairing with a VSC-HVDC grid; Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid centres on the first DC grid in the world: a four-terminal ring, yearly energy, energy in submodule capacitors, fault current rise and DC breakers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上池蓄能量」與「年輸送電量占北京用電的比例」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「交流勵磁變速機組」的模型移到張北柔性直流電網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直流故障電流的上升率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Yearly energy as a share of Beijing demand".
Move the model of "AC-excited variable-speed units" to Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rate of rise of DC fault current", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「配合風光基地的調節任務」與「變速機組與抽水調節」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；張北柔性直流電網的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Balancing a wind and solar base" and "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 豐寧抽蓄水電站
history.text: 2013 年一期工程開工；2021 年首批機組於 12 月投產；2022 年為北京冬季奧運提供綠電調節；2024 年12 台機組全部投產，含 2 台變速機組。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2013: Phase one began. 2021: The first units entered service in December. 2022: It provided balancing for green power at the Beijing Winter Olympics. 2024: All twelve units, including the two variable-speed machines, were in service. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
